description: Searches webhooks with the specified criteria and pagination.

description.description: The description of the webhook to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

orderBy.description: The field to order the results by. Supported values: description, id, insertInstant, url.

startRow.description: The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

tenantId.description: The tenant Id to restrict the results to.

url.description: The URL of the webhook to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

name: searchWebhooksByParametersWithId
